spans.text: ...In the end, 416 comes before UMP9.
She has decided to go after what she wants.
9, I'm taking part in Griffin's rescue mission.
Are you sure you know what you're doing?
I'm doing what I want to do.
You know who they're trying to rescue.
But...rescuing her isn't our job.
At least she didn't give us this assignment.
Which is why I want to go. It's my own decision.
You seem to have changed...
I've had enough...of working to live up to others' expectations...
I'm going to stop chasing after someone else, be it you or Griffin.
...I understand.
But that doesn't mean you have to rescue her, does it?
Do you know how dangerous it is in there?
I won't be alone.
The Commander will oversee the operation, and the remaining members of the AR Team will accompany me.
I want to learn more from this mission - things I can't learn in Squad 404 - to better prepare myself for the future.
416, you'll be back, right? It's tiring having to walk by myself.
I will return once the mission is accomplished.
But you still ought to train properly. One day, you'll have to change, too.
Ughhh... I'll...try.
SOP-II...she's calling for you. We'll be going then. You know where to find us.
You must come back. Otherwise, when 45 wakes up—
I'm not coming back for her. She can think whatever she wants.
But I WILL come back. You know I'm a Doll of my word.
Alright... I get it...
Good. I'll be right back.
Are you sure you wanna come?
Both Griffin's and 404's transports have already left, I have no other options now.
Haha...
I thought you...were a really tough person.
I've only realized recently that I'm actually not.
I'm scared...experience that I don't have, unknown enemies, unfamiliar companions...
If I can't overcome these problems, I won't survive on the battlefield in the future.
Have you figured out how to overcome them then?
Of course.
All it takes is for me to enjoy them for what they are.
Your account matches our information.
Squad 404's current whereabouts are unknown, but 416 will lead us to them.
You know where she is, correct?

choices: She never would have told me.

spans.text: Indeed, we have no evidence to either support or refute your claim.
We know. It is an answer we expected.
Then I can assume that she does not trust you all that much.
But it matters not. We have a way to find out.
One of the Nytos takes a syringe out of a box. I know what that is.
You have probably undergone resistance training, but this will open up certain possibilities for us.
The Nyto injects the truth serum into my body.
What we wish to see is the regret on your face after you spill everything.
Give us the satisfaction, Griffin Commander.
My mind begins to unwind. I can tell the serum is kicking in.
I know how to deal with it, but I'm not sure how well it'll work.
I must believe the story I'm about to tell... I must believe it myself...
You've bought us time, Commander. We have already infiltrated the hospital, but it's going to take a little longer to sabotage the surveillance instruments and take care of the guards. Hang in there.
Oh, and thank you for your stories. They're positively compelling.
Griffin Commander, we are now entering the final stage of the interrogation.
Tactical Dolls M4 SOPMOD II and 416 both took part in the operation to rescue a certain human.
Angelia, former Griffin Commander.
We need to know the whereabouts of these three individuals. You must start from the beginning so we can facilitate our fact checks.
Angelia... I know that...
To prevent myself from telling the truth, I must believe the things I "recall" in my mind.
I have to let myself drift along in the ocean...and capture every piece of fantasy that I think is real...
I know what's the most believable in Ange's case...
...Death.
...Tell us, and you can live.
I'll have to cover up the truth with all sorts of deaths...
But I must also remember the truth...
Where Ange has gone... How I ended up here... I must remember it all...
This will be the final story, I'll arrive at my own ending very soon. I hope that the ladies of 404 will make it a good one.
